title: Working Zones Introduction and Seal Ring's Housing
topics: Working zones for seal and bearing assemblies
Chamfer and fillet requirements for seal seats
Assembly sequence for bearings and seals with same diameter
rules: Minimum effective dimension a = 1 mm for working zones
When dimension doesn't allow larger sizing, use a = 1 mm (effective minimum)
Chamfer radius R varies based on diameter: ød ≤ 60 → R = 0.4 mm; ød > 60 ÷ 120 → R = 0.8 mm; ød > 120 → R = 1.2 mm
For bearing and seal ring with same fitting diameter (dc = da): seal ring assembly must be followed by bearing assembly
Zone 'L' must be dimensioned with specific tolerance to indicate useful length of execution
Rounded edges and sharp corners must be avoided on seal seats
Surface finish symbol refers to surfaces possibly with plunge grinding machining and without roughness a/o helical riflings
dimensions: a = 1 mm minimum effective working zone dimension
a ≤ 2 mm typically for dimensioning (Bonfiglioli internal standard)
Length L must be specified with tolerance for bearing/seal assembly zones
tolerances: Zone 'L' must indicate the specific tolerance assigned
Working zone dimension tolerance to be clearly indicated on drawings
surface_finish: Surface finishing possibly with plunge grinding machining without roughness or helical riflings
Sharp edges must be avoided (rounded edges required)
Surface must be free of helical riflings to prevent seal damage
inspection: Verify minimum dimension a ≥ 1 mm for working zones
Check chamfer radius R matches diameter range specification
Verify absence of sharp corners or edges on seal seats
Confirm surface finish is free of helical riflings
manufacturing_notes: Use plunge grinding where possible for seal seat surfaces to avoid helical riflings
Ensure rounded edges or chamfers are applied - no sharp corners permitted
When assembling bearing and seal with same diameter, always install seal first, then bearing
Working zone must remain within specified zones to avoid interference with other features
training_guidance: NX agent should automatically add 1 mm minimum working zone (dimension 'a') when creating seal ring housing features
Apply chamfer radius based on housing diameter: R = 0.4 mm for ød ≤ 60 mm, R = 0.8 mm for 60 < ød ≤ 120 mm, R = 1.2 mm for ød > 120 mm
When modeling seal seats in housings, ensure all edges are rounded or chamfered - flag any sharp corners as errors
For bearing and seal combinations with identical fitting diameter, annotate assembly sequence: seal first, bearing second
Apply surface finish symbols indicating plunge grinding without helical patterns on seal seat surfaces
Dimension zone 'L' with explicit tolerance callout on technical drawings to indicate useful execution length
Validate that working zone dimension 'a' does not exceed 2 mm per Bonfiglioli internal standards unless specifically required
summary: This standard defines working zone introduction requirements for seal ring housings in Bonfiglioli gearbox assemblies. Key requirements include a minimum 1 mm working zone dimension, diameter-dependent chamfer radii (0.4-1.2 mm), and prohibition of sharp edges on seal seats. Special assembly sequencing is required when bearings and seals share the same fitting diameter, with seals always installed before bearings.
